summary: When life actually goes your way for once, you don't have to immediately brace for the other shoe to drop or squeeze a five-year plan out of a moment of genuine grace.
body: When life actually goes your way for once, you don't have to immediately brace for the other shoe to drop or squeeze a five-year plan out of a moment of genuine grace. When the Moon trines Jupiter, optimism and emotional openness reinforce each other, making unexpected encouragement, affection, or good news much easier to receive without the usual preemptive panic. Let a piece of good fortune simply make your world feel a little larger today. You are allowed to enjoy a win without turning it into an obligation.
